data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for fetching the device's mobile number or list sim cards data.
data.what_it_does: Allows fetching the device's mobile number and listing available SIM cards on Android. Provides methods to check and request phone permissions.
use_when: You need to retrieve the user's phone number on Android
You need to list SIM card details for dual-SIM devices on Android
avoid_when: You are developing for iOS (not supported)
The phone number is critical and may not be pre-stored on the SIM card
weaknesses: Works for Android only; iOS is not supported
Will not return a phone number if it is not pre-existing on the SIM card
data.setup_notes: Requires Android phone permissions. May require additional configuration for older deprecated FlutterActivity implementations on MainActivity.java.
